definitionZh: 将样式从直立调整为斜立。 负值产生右拾遗表,也被打字员称为"oblique"风格. 正值产生左拾遗形式,也称为"背斜的"或"反斜的"风格.
sourceDefinition: Adjust the style from upright to slanted. Negative values produce right-leaning forms, also known to typographers as an 'oblique' style. Positive values produce left-leaning forms, also called a 'backslanted' or 'reverse oblique' style.
